mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating industrial production (INDPRO growth > 1.0% YoY), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it indicates slowing labor market growth that dampens consumer confidence and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the central bank is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.
